title: OpenDEA Component Reference
description: The consumer-side typed, versioned reference through which a maturity model reuses a published MaturityComponent (CR-AM-10 §4). Every reference declares a kind (controlled vocabulary: vocabulary/reference-kinds.yaml): import (consume exactly as published at the pinned version; no consumer-local payload permitted), extend (consume and add consumer-local items; the published component is unchanged), or override (consume with declared replacements — every override names what it replaces and why). A reference without a kind is refused: there is no fourth, implicit kind, and no silent inheritance. The component is always pinned by id AND version — composition never tracks a moving target.

id.description: Optional identifier for the reference itself, used when reconciliation rules or baselines need to cite the reference.

component.description: The pinned component being referenced. Version is mandatory (stricter than common modelReference): composition always resolves against an immutable component version.

kind.description: How the consumer uses the component. import: verbatim, no payload. extend: consumer-local additions. override: declared replacements with rationale.

additions.description: Consumer-local items added on top of the component. Permitted only when kind = extend; mandatory for extend.

replaces.description: Component content entries the consumer declares replaced. Permitted only when kind = override; mandatory for override.

rationale.description: Why the override exists. Mandatory when kind = override; overrides are the highest-drift-risk kind and are surfaced in conformance reports.
